cases.name: Kadidra Rayjean Roberts
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "As a young child, she was full of love and laughter. She loved to sing and dance, and spend time with family and friends.

She found God at a young age, going to church with her mom, siblings and cousins. As a teenager, she loved to show off her talent. She taught herself to play the piano, the violin and she even rapped a little bit. Whatever she set her mind to, she achieved it. Kadidra went on to receive her G.E.D. She became a loving mom to two beautiful daughters and one handsome son. Kadidra was loved by everyone she came in contact with. Her smile always lit up the sky.

Kadidra departed this world and reunited with her son, Kashmere Roberts in Heaven."
cases.narrative: On 9/3/2022, police found her body after residents found decomposing human remains, in a shallow wooded grave in Elsmere, KY. “Myers described wrapping Roberts in fabric, putting her in the large green trash bin, and dumping her in a grave he dug in the woods. Myers stated he put Roberts’s wig and clothes into a garbage bag and threw them in the trash,” the arrest warrant states.
